0.22November 27, 2026

  • AddedCopy as Patch on Source Control change rows

  • ImprovedCopied chat text keeps its links when pasted
  • ImprovedSlash command suggestions rank most-used commands first
  • ImprovedGo Back returns to previewed pages where they were read
  • ImprovedHover docs select across prose, code, and dependency cards
  • ImprovedDependency cards show the lockfile version when not installed
  • ImprovedOpening symlinks selects the link's tree row
  • ImprovedDrags from sidebar lists' empty space select rows
  • ImprovedPane dividers drag from the toolbar band
  • ImprovedWrapped lines break after punctuation, never after indent alone
  • ImprovedDiff find centers matches, as the editor does
  • ImprovedTag lists shelve all but 10 under Previous, with counts
  • ImprovedWorking Copy opens on its last change
  • ImprovedSyntax Coloring menu checks the detected language
  • ImprovedUntitled buffers drop a stale language guess
  • ImprovedMissing markdown images show muted alt text and their path
  • ImprovedFollowed run tabs say "Waiting for output…" until they print
  • ImprovedUsage meters roll over at their window's reset
  • ImprovedSidebar workspace titles show the folder path on hover
  • ImprovedSwitching chats with long recent lists is faster
  • ImprovedSettings' back and forward step through subpages
  • ImprovedSave to Downloads behind ⌥ in image menus
  • ImprovedShow Frame Rate moves to General settings
  • ImprovedNew windows open at 1060 by 660
  • FixedContext gauges read right after compactions and restores
  • FixedScheduled jobs no longer hold account switches when out of quota
  • FixedGit undo presses during a running step beep instead of queuing
  • FixedRuboCop servers stop once their folder is gone or untrusted
  • FixedThe clones folder is no longer offered for trust

  • FixedTitlebar double-clicks over the sidebar zoom the window

  • ImprovedTask edit forms' command fields wrap and grow

  • ImprovedRun output's Output button reads Copy to Editor

  • FixedEmptied files' hunks stage and discard
  • FixedRun output no longer flashes its scroller while following

  • FixedComposer suggestions stop offering to commit committed work
